fields.description: Whatever you want to call it: Hot, Price Shopper, Ghosted.
fields.label: State Name

fields.description: Position in the funnel, low to high. Used to decide what counts as moving backwards.
fields.label: Rank

fields.description: A contact lands in this state once their score reaches this number. The highest qualifying state wins.
fields.label: Minimum Score

fields.description: Terminal states (Converted, Lost, Opted Out) are set by a rule and never by score, and nothing moves out of them automatically.
fields.label: Is Terminal

fields.description: Allow a contact in this state to fall back to a lower one, for example going cold after weeks of silence.
fields.label: Allow Regression

fields.description: Assign the matched CRM Lead to someone the moment a contact reaches this state. This is how a hot lead reaches a person instead of sitting in a list.
fields.label: Assign On Entry

fields.description: Leave blank to assign to the lead's owner.
fields.label: Assign To

fields.description: Shown on the assignment, e.g. "Asked about pricing on WhatsApp, call today".
fields.label: Note

fields.description: Optional. When set, and when MSG91 Settings has Auto Write Lead Status enabled, the matched CRM Lead is moved to this status.
fields.label: Set Lead Status To

fields.description: What this state means to your team.
fields.label: Description
